title: MONTH_24 — Medical History
description: Doctor visits, hospital attendance, symptoms, iron, medication and supplement items, breathlessness, ECG and the restless-legs questions, from the 24-month questionnaire.
$comment: Items carry the source's own codes: 998 = not applicable on 17 item families whose universe the dictionary does not state (D014), and a plain '999 = don't know' (no 'prefer not to answer') on some items, inlined with the source's own label.
